**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Limit lead exemptions to actual job-title uses**

When interface copy contains a safe-title prefix followed by commercial wordingΓÇöfor example, `sales team lead generation` or `clinical lead capture`ΓÇöthe negative lookbehind suppresses the only `lead` match, while neither `generation` nor `capture` matches another alternative. The static governance scan therefore accepts commercial lead-language it is intended to reject; constrain the exemption to actual job-title uses and add a mixed-phrase regression case.
